title: A radicial morphism of algebraic spaces is universally injective
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma upgrades the pointwise definition of a radicial morphism (injective on points with purely inseparable residue field extensions, checked after any base change by the definition's universal quantification) to the valuative-style lifting property characterizing universally injective morphisms of algebraic spaces. The retained proof is short and complete: given any morphism Spec(K) -> Y, the definition of radicial bounds the number of lifts to X by at most one, and the characterization lemma in Morphisms of Spaces (universal injectivity iff lifts against spectra of fields are unique) concludes. Retained author proof at lines 72-81.
